text: OVERDOSAGE If treatment dose is swallowed (less than 100 mg F), administer milk, limewater, or calcium-type antacid. In case of larger doses (1 pint contains 4.5 grams F ion, which is a lethal dose), use ipecac syrup emetic and immediately seek medical help. Overdose symptoms include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain.
